title: Coral Casino UK App: The Gaming World in Your Pocket

content.text: British users are increasingly choosing the mobile gambling format. This is a great opportunity to enjoy a huge variety of games on compact mobile devices. In fact, the entire world of gambling entertainment fits in your pocket.

Coral Casino is a modern platform that has a somewhat outdated interface, but offers a large selection of games and sports betting. Users have a great opportunity to play on smartphones and tablets. There are 2 options available for this - install the application or use the capabilities of the mobile version of the site.

Please note that Coral applications differ depending on whether you want to play on Android or iOS devices. In this review, you will learn the differences in applications, as well as where and how to install them depending on the operating system of your smartphone or tablet.

For users of Android devices, the official Coral Casino application is available. It can be installed by clicking on the link on the official website, or by opening the Google Play store. Please note that the application is not installed via APK files. Therefore, if you see an offer to download APK to install the Coral Casino application on third-party sites, refuse.
The advantage of the Android version is full access to all types of gambling casino games in a compact mobile application. But there is no section with sports betting.
To date, the Coral Casino application has been downloaded more than 500 thousand times, and the rating on the official Google app store is 4.4 with 12.8 thousand reviews.

The Android application offers a full range of bonuses, hundreds of exciting games, fully adapted to the mobile operating system. Here you can also pick up a bonus for new customers. Unlike the site, when playing through the application, you will receive £50 if you place bets for £10.
Users of Apple devices may be somewhat disappointed, since there is no official Coral Casino application. Instead, a mobile app with sports betting from Coral is available for iOS devices.
To download and install the app, visit the Coral website or go to the official App Store. Find Coral TM and quickly download the app.

After installation and registration, users of the Coral mobile app will be able to activate the welcome bonus. To do this, you need to make a deposit and place a bet of at least £5. Once you fulfill these conditions, £20 will be credited to your balance in the form of a free bet.

In both cases, when downloading and installing Coral applications, there are no special bonuses for games through the mobile program. But you will be able to activate all bonus offers as on the official website.

Many users of Android and iOS devices want to get full access to all the features of Coral, and not be limited to casino games and sports betting. Therefore, you can skip the mobile application and go the alternative route.

A great solution is to use the capabilities and advantages of the mobile version of the site. The service is developed in HTML5 format, which allows you to play equally conveniently on any type of device with different types of operating systems.

sections.heading: Quick and Convenient Access to the Mobile Version

content.text: If you are tired of opening your mobile browser every time, searching for Coral Casino through the search bar and going to the site, use a simple and convenient solution. You can create a shortcut to the home screen for instant access to Coral.

items: Open the browser on your mobile device
Go to the official Coral Casino website
Click the Menu button of your web browser
Confirm the creation of the shortcut

content.text: Using this method, you can create 2 shortcuts at once if you play at the casino and place bets on the Coral platform equally often. The first shortcut will instantly redirect to the Casino games section, and the second will be used specifically for quick access to sports betting.

Coral Casino has been successfully operating since 2011. The service offers a wide range of gaming options, numerous promotions, and bonus programs. Another undeniable advantage is the ability to install mobile applications.
Please note that only the Coral sports betting application is available for iOS, while a full range of casino games, including live dealers, is offered for Android.
